query_text: Create a bubble chart for the 12 non-conflict countries in the 2021 report with the largest positive best-city advantage, where the x-axis is `covid_rank - best visible city rank`, the y-axis is `total sampled innovations / number of visible ranked cities`, bubble size is sampled-innovation density in sampled innovations per 1 million people, Canada and Sweden are excluded, countries must have at least one visible ranked city, and the 12 plotted countries are chosen only after `covid_rank - best visible city rank` has been derived.
value_unit: x in rank positions; y in sampled innovations per visible city; bubble size in sampled innovations per 1M people
selection_rule: positive advantages only, capped at top 12 after excluding Canada/Sweden

plot_spec.title: 2021 Best-City Advantage vs Innovations per City
plot_spec.xlabel: Country rank minus best visible city rank
